why_it_was_acquired: admin1 closed 805 of the 986 title collisions but not all of them, because some countries have few admin1 regions: Great Britain has four, so two English towns of one name both resolve to England. admin2 is the county or municipality level and separates the rest. Coverage in the markets is uneven and that is the point of measuring it: BR 5,570 and US 3,143 and JP 1,190 are well covered, DE has 19 and TW 22, so this closes the collisions in the countries that actually have them.
